Container.Name: thermohub
Container.Overview: Connects to Cookidoo and shows your Thermomix shopping list, and compares Woolworths and Coles prices for it. After installing, open the WebUI and connect your Cookidoo account from there; no settings needed here.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Port the web page and API are served on. Change the host side if 8000 is taken.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Keeps the Cookidoo sign-in so restarts don't need a fresh one. Your password is never stored.

Config.Name: Access key
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the Thermohub page asks for this key once per browser.

Config.Name: Cookidoo email (optional)
Config.Description: Leave blank and connect Cookidoo from the Thermohub page instead. If set, Thermohub signs in with it automatically.

Config.Name: Cookidoo password (optional)
Config.Description: Only used with the email above.

Config.Name: Cookidoo country
Config.Description: Default Cookidoo country until one is picked on the Settings page (au = cookidoo.com.au).

Config.Name: Cookidoo language
Config.Description: Default Cookidoo language until one is picked on the Settings page.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the appdata files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the appdata files (100 = users).
